answer: Proof of stake acts as a barrier against Sybil attacks in an AI economy by tethering network influence to verifiable capital. Much like a raven scanning for a hidden thread in the digital dawn, validators must lock assets to participate, ensuring that creating infinite identities provides no advantage. An attacker incurs prohibitive costs because the capital requirement scales linearly with the number of identities, rendering large-scale identity spoofing economically irrational and technically futile.
